name: linear
title: Linear issue worker
description: Starts a session on each Linear issue with a target's label, in that target's repo and keyed by the issue, and ends it when the issue is completed or canceled. The agent reads the issue through Linear's MCP server.

targets.ask: a Linear label per repo, e.g. scotty:web → owner/web

connections.name: linear-issues

ask.prompt: the signing secret Linear shows for the webhook (create the webhook with the hook URL first)

connections.setup: In Linear's Settings → API → Webhooks, create a webhook with the hook URL and the Issues data change event, then paste the signing secret Linear shows.

connections.name: linear

ask.prompt: a Linear API key, or nothing to sign in with OAuth after installing

connections.setup: Without an API key, sign in once: scotty mcp signin linear (or Connect in Settings → Connections). Tools are read-only until you widen them: scotty mcp policy linear all.

automations.name: linear-new-${target}
automations.prompt:
Work on Linear issue {{data.identifier}}: {{data.title}} ({{url}}).

Read the issue and its comments with the Linear MCP server at http://linear.internal/api/mcp, then do the work on this branch, run the tests, and push it. Say what you did and what is left.

automations.name: linear-labelled-${target}
automations.prompt:
Work on Linear issue {{data.identifier}}: {{data.title}} ({{url}}). Its labels changed.

Read the issue and its comments with the Linear MCP server at http://linear.internal/api/mcp, then do the work on this branch, run the tests, and push it. Say what you did and what is left.
